en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard shows a large Orthodox church with multiple domes and tall bell towers rising behind lower buildings and trees. The architecture is Byzantine‑revival, with arched windows and a prominent central nave. At the bottom of the image there is a dark banner with Greek handwriting identifying the church. A web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible across the lower right part of the image.
